overview: The City Council addressed business licences and outdoor dining requests for Wendy's and Bertucci's, reviewed municipal contract issues involving Comcast and Republic Parking, and discussed road repairs and substance abuse initiatives.

items.title: Keno to Go Notice, 335 Main Street
items.summary: Voted non-opposition to a Keno to Go installation at 335 Main Street.

items.title: Unity Cab Vehicle License Transfer
items.summary: Tabled the license transfer petition because the applicant failed to attend an earlier subcommittee meeting.

items.title: National Grid Pole and Wire Installation, Valley Place
items.summary: Approved a petition by National Grid to install a utility pole and overhead wires to service 727 Fellsway, with amendments requesting restoration standards and attention to a hanging wire on Bradbury Street.

items.title: Wendy's Outdoor Dining License
items.summary: Approved an outdoor dining license for Wendy's at 330 Mystic Avenue with conditions, including closing the patio at 8 p.m., covering the area with a locked tarp after hours, and a six-month review.

items.title: Wendy's Extended Drive-Thru Hours
items.summary: Reconsidered and approved Wendy's petition for drive-thru service from 11 p.m. to 3 a.m. with a six-month review, tying the permit solely to the business.

items.title: Bertucci's Outdoor Dining License
items.summary: Approved an outdoor dining license for Bertucci's at 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway for a 32-seat patio, ending outdoor seating 30 minutes prior to closing and referring related legal questions to the city solicitor.

items.title: Subcommittee Report on Meeting DVD Copy Fees
items.summary: Approved a Rules Committee report adjusting council meeting DVD fees to $5 for citizen copies within six months and $10 for copies older than six months.

items.title: Subcommittee Report on Substance Abuse Prevention Coordinator
items.summary: Adopted recommendations directing the city solicitor to draft an ordinance creating a full-time substance abuse prevention coordinator, supporting Narcan implementation for police and fire personnel, and using reverse 911 for resource outreach.

items.title: Autism Awareness Observance
items.summary: Approved a resolution to observe Autism Speaks' "Light It Up Blue" initiative on April 2nd, including spotlighting City Hall in blue.

items.title: Commendation for Maria Daniels
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating Maria Daniels for receiving the Massachusetts Cultural Council's Leadership Circle Award.

items.title: Comcast Cable Contract Renewal
items.summary: Approved a resolution advising the mayor not to enter into any new contract agreement with Comcast until a public hearing is held, along with an accompanying request asking the city solicitor to investigate allowable uses of franchise fees and rules governing public access channels.

items.title: Republic Parking Enforcement Contract and Kiosks
items.summary: Tabled a motion recommending the termination of the city's parking management contract with Republic Parking following extensive debate over ticketing practices, signage, and kiosk performance.

items.title: Winthrop Street Raised Crosswalk Striping
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that a portion of state winter recovery aid be used to restripe the raised crosswalk on Winthrop Street.

items.title: State Aid for Winter Road and Pothole Repairs
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging the city to promptly participate in the state's $143,334 winter road recovery funding allocation to address potholes and surface damage.

items.title: 2015 Municipal Election Calendar
items.summary: Accepted the official 2015 municipal election schedule announced by the city clerk.

items.title: Commendation for Team Medford Vigil
items.summary: Approved a resolution commending Team Medford for organizing a community vigil regarding addiction awareness.

items.title: Illegal Dumping Removal on Elm and Fulton Streets
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that DPW remove an illegally dumped mattress, box spring, and television at Elm and Fulton streets.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved amended meeting records from February 24 and March 17, 2015.
